title: Cell
description: One unit of manager automation: trigger -> gather -> diff -> write -> gate -> land -> brief -> record. Harness-neutral. Company-specific values live in config and in the tools file, never in the cell body. A run is complete only when the done-means contract holds in its run directory (evidence.json, diff.md, draft.md with a Sources header, gate.md with passes >= min_passes, brief.md of three lines, result.json).

kind.description: writer produces a document through a skill and a gate; consumer reads other cells' ledgers; collector only fills a cache

component.description: graph partition this cell belongs to; the private one (default 'hr') is a separate connected component

workspace.description: required for the private component: the folder and memory partition the cell runs in

agent.description: Bot or agent template that should run this cell on harnesses that have one

events.description: event descriptions a heartbeat watches for, e.g. 'calendar item <Name> : <Me> | 1 on 1 minus 1 day'

role.description: namespaced capability, e.g. docs.read, chat.search, tasks.list; resolved through tools.json

ref.description: locator for the role (doc id, channel, query); may use ${config.x}

second_opinion.description: after the gate, an independent critic on this harness evaluates draft.md against the evidence; findings are recorded in meta.json, they never edit or block

fixture.description: evidence file used by --dry-run, relative to the cell file

coverage.description: source coverage a writer cell must meet; check fails otherwise

require_roles.description: roles that must appear among sources, e.g. a corroboration role

brief.description: optional: where the three-line brief.md goes besides the run dir
